intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Tavri is rehearsing smiles in the back of a spoon. She has three.

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “This one’s for ministers. This one’s for visiting nobles.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “And this one’s for when someone asks why I’m not smiling.”

intro.speaker: TAVRI
intro.text: “I haven’t scheduled a meeting with that one.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Upside down in the spoon, all three smiles look equally tired.

options.labelText: “Try none of them. If anyone asks, you’re thinking very hard about soup.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Imagine the headlines. *Princess’s Face Found Relaxed. Court in Uproar.*”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She pockets the spoon. Her face settles into something she didn’t rehearse.

options.labelText: “The third one’s the most convincing. Use it on everyone.”

branch.speaker: TAVRI
branch.text: “Efficient. One smile, whole kingdom, no refunds.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She puts it on and leaves it there. It’s still there when she says goodbye.
